patterns.note: Extremely generous vertical whitespace, especially in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a minimalist and impactful presentation.
Dramatic use of oversized, bold, wide sans-serif typography for primary headings, contrasting with smaller, legible sans-serif for body and caption text.
The initial hero title 'SONS & DAUGHTERS' transitions from a large, centered display to a smaller, sticky logo in the top-left corner upon scroll.
A navigation menu appears from the top right of the viewport as the user scrolls past the initial hero, coinciding with the header transition.
Content sections, such as the grid of portrait images, reveal from the bottom of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.

technique_notes: The hero title is initially displayed as a large, centered element. Upon scrolling, it smoothly scales down and repositions to become a fixed, smaller logo in the top-left corner of the viewport.
A navigation menu is initially hidden and then slides or fades into view from the top right as the user scrolls, becoming part of the sticky header.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, appearing to enter the viewport from below, creating a sense of progression through the narrative.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~5-6x body text) with generous letter spacing, contrasted with smaller, legible body and caption text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all image frames and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a deliberate sense of space and focus.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme use of negative space and monumental, bold typography for primary headings, which gives it an editorial, art-gallery-like feel rather than a typical marketing site. The initial hero is almost entirely whitespace, drawing immediate attention to the brand name.
